text: On 13.07.2024 at about 0449 hrs, a written complaint was received at Loni Police Station from Selvam Chettiar, resident of Loni, Ghaziabad. It is alleged that the accused persons operating from Loni, Ghaziabad created a fake customer-care listing and induced the complainant to install a screen-sharing application. An amount of Rs.56,076 was siphoned off through 17 UPI transactions to a VPA linked with account 357843701180. Technical analysis of IP logs points to devices used by Kuldeep Thakur and Ravi Poojary, both allegedly working under the direction of Chandrabhan Baghel @ Chandrabhan Kallu. Accordingly a case under section IT Act 66C/66D (BNS 319(2)) has been registered vide FIR No. 414/2024 at Loni Police Station and investigation has been taken up.

During patrolling duty on 27.01.2019 at 0002 hrs near Mamdot, Ferozepur, the patrolling staff of Mamdot Police Station noticed suspicious movement. He stated that the material was handed over to him by Harjinder Kang, r/o Ullal, who works at the instance of Yallappa Acharya. The seized contraband was weighed in the presence of independent witnesses and sealed with seal impression 'XCV'. Accordingly a case under section NDPS 21(c)/29 (BNS -) has been registered vide FIR No. 598/2019 at Mamdot Police Station and investigation has been taken up.
